sloka: तथा शपन्त्यां वैदेह्यां प्रादुरासीत्तदद्भुतम् ।भूतलादुत्थितं दिव्यं सिंहासनमनुत्तमम् ।। ७.९७.१८ ॥
transliteration: tathā śapantyāṁ vaidehyāṁ prādurāsīttadadbhutam ।bhūtalādutthitaṁ divyaṁ siṁhāsanamanuttamam ।। 7.97.18 ॥

translations.english: As Vaidehi was thus swearing, a wonderful, divine, and unsurpassed throne emerged from the surface of the earth.
